name: Candeleda (Spain)
description: Square crimson flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Candeleda (a chequy field, a bend and a mountain).
history: The vexillological description of the flag (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 202 of 19 October 1994) is a square flag of proportion 1:1, crimson, with the municipal arms in their colours at the centre.

features.role: Candeleda arms — chequy, bend and mountain
